root_cause: The datepicker's `_formatDate` method uses locale-aware formatting (`toLocaleDateString`) as the default for all elements, including `<input>` elements. This causes ISO format dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in input fields to be reformatted to locale-specific formats (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY for en-US) on initialization, breaking form submission expectations.
repair_strategy: Modify `_formatDate` to use ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) as the default for input elements, preserving form compatibility, while keeping locale-aware formatting for non-input display elements.
expected_accessibility_effect: Preserves the expected date format in form inputs for screen reader users and keyboard navigators, ensuring the announced value matches the submitted value.
functional_risks: Only changes default formatting for input elements without explicit dateFormat config
Non-input elements (buttons, inline calendars) retain locale formatting
Custom dateFormat functions/objects still work as before
verification_requirements: Tab through departure date field without picking a date, change passengers, save - verify departure remains 2026-10-22 in form submission
Verify return date (non-input with explicit dateFormat) still shows "October 22, 2026" format
Verify date picker still works correctly when picking a date
Verify multiple date selection modes still work
